sections.body: On early downs, set the front to stop Hampton, who takes 54.5% of carries [mc8], and force LAC into obvious passing situations. On third and long, NE's protection matters most: LAC drops back on 90.8% of snaps [mc9] over 65 plays [mc10] and sends extra rushers on 23.8% of dropbacks [mc11], while NE allows a 6.9% sack rate [mc14]. Keep backs and tight ends in to protect and get the ball out quick. Third down is where NE's sustained drives can extend, since LAC allows conversions on 40.0% of attempts [mc16], so prioritize quick-game and option routes. In the secondary, T.Harris takes 15.5% of LAC targets [mc21], and with Davis out, the answer on Harris matters most. If McConkey sits, Kolar's 8.9% target share [mc23] is the next read.
